concerns.location: tasks.md: Phase 1 T003 vs Phase 2 T004
concerns.text: T003 trains a RandomForest and reports held-out R²/r/p in quick_metrics.json BEFORE T004 runs the power analysis that gates all modeling (FR-015/FR-023: 'Abort ... do not proceed on an underpowered dataset'). The plan orders power analysis (Phase 3) before any split/training (Phases 4-5). As written, the underpowered-abort gate is consumed after a model has already been trained and metrics published, defeating the gate's purpose. Move the power analysis into Phase 1 (between T003's dataset build and its quick-model step, or as a separate task before T003's training).

T010 asserts 'the full pipeline completes within the free-runner budget' and records wall-clock/peak memory, but T010 executes before T011 (figures) and T012 (report/manifest), which are part of the full pipeline. The runtime measurement would cover an incomplete pipeline. Either move the runtime assertion to T013 (which already re-runs end-to-end) or scope T010(c) to 'the analysis pipeline through T009'.

T009's stability runs re-execute 'the full train/evaluate/importance pipeline' (T005–T007), while plan Phase 10 says to repeat Phases 4–9, which includes Phase 7 external validation. The dependency note ('T009 depends on the full pipeline of T005–T007') is internally consistent, but the plan/tasks scope mismatch should be reconciled so the executor knows whether external validation is inside the three-seed loop.
